+"""Shared, broker-neutral contracts for long-only SELL strategies.
+
+SELL rules only identify when an owned long should be fully exited. They never
+submit orders. The ordinary ``SellStrategy.evaluate`` SDK remains the public
+trigger interface; ``SellRule`` supplies common data checks before delegating
+to ``evaluate_trigger``. Position and minimum-hold checks are available as a
+separate pure evaluator for the composition layer that has the confirmed
+position snapshot.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from abc import abstractmethod
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import ClassVar, Mapping
+
+from mike_trade.domain.signals import SignalAction
+from mike_trade.domain.strategy_types import StrategyRole
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import ManagementStatus, Position, PositionDirection
+from mike_trade.market_data.context import MarketContext
+from mike_trade.strategies.base import (
+    ReasonCode,
+    SellStrategy,
+    StrategyEvaluation,
+    StrategySpec,
+    make_signal_id,
+)
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SellRule",
+    "ExitLongRecommendation",
+    "ExitSource",
+    "EXIT_PRIORITY",
+    "evaluate_exit_eligibility",
+    "min_hold_applies",
+    "SellReasonCode",
+]
+
+
+class SellReasonCode(Enum):
+    """SELL contract diagnostics, including generic evaluation disposition."""
+
+    ELIGIBLE = "ELIGIBLE"
+    NO_SIGNAL = "NO_SIGNAL"
+    NOT_ELIGIBLE = "NOT_ELIGIBLE"
+    FLAT_POSITION = "FLAT_POSITION"
+    UNMANAGED_POSITION = "UNMANAGED_POSITION"
+    NON_POSITIVE_QUANTITY = "NON_POSITIVE_QUANTITY"
+    NOT_LONG = "NOT_LONG"
+    STRATEGY_DISABLED = "STRATEGY_DISABLED"
+    NO_DATA = "NO_DATA"
+    STALE_DATA = "STALE_DATA"
+    INCOMPLETE_DATA = "INCOMPLETE_DATA"
+    NOT_WARMED = "NOT_WARMED"
+    MINIMUM_HOLD = "MINIMUM_HOLD"
+
+
+class ExitSource(Enum):
+    """Origin of an exit request; only ordinary strategy exits use minimum hold."""
+
+    PROTECTIVE_STOP = "PROTECTIVE_STOP"
+    MANUAL_CLOSE = "MANUAL_CLOSE"
+    HARD_RISK = "HARD_RISK"
+    FORCED_LIQUIDATION = "FORCED_LIQUIDATION"
+    STRATEGY_SELL = "STRATEGY_SELL"
+
+
+# Lower numbers win arbitration. Safety and operator initiated exits precede
+# strategy opinions; Phase k.4 consumes this stable ordering.
+EXIT_PRIORITY: Mapping[ExitSource, int] = MappingProxyType(
+    {
+        ExitSource.PROTECTIVE_STOP: 0,
+        ExitSource.MANUAL_CLOSE: 1,
+        ExitSource.HARD_RISK: 2,
+        ExitSource.FORCED_LIQUIDATION: 3,
+        ExitSource.STRATEGY_SELL: 4,
+    }
+)
+
+
+def min_hold_applies(source: ExitSource) -> bool:
+    """Return whether ``source`` must honor the ordinary strategy hold period."""
+    if not isinstance(source, ExitSource):
+        raise ValueError("source must be ExitSource")
+    return source is ExitSource.STRATEGY_SELL
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, init=False)
+class ExitLongRecommendation:
+    """Advisory to exit the entire confirmed remainder of one managed long."""
+
+    signal_id: str
+    strategy_id: str
+    version: str
+    symbol: str
+    position_cycle_id: str
+    bar_time: datetime
+    quantity: Decimal
+    reason_codes: tuple[SellReasonCode, ...]
+    action: SignalAction = SignalAction.EXIT_LONG
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        signal_id: str,
+        strategy_id: str,
+        version: str,
+        position: Position,
+        bar_time: datetime,
+        reason_codes: tuple[SellReasonCode, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        """Build from the managed position; quantity and cycle id are derived."""
+        if not isinstance(position, Position):
+            raise ValueError("position must be a Position")
+        if position.management is not ManagementStatus.MANAGED or not position.cycle_id:
+            raise ValueError("recommendations require an owned managed position")
+        if position.quantity <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("recommendations require a positive confirmed remainder")
+        normalized_bar_time = _utc(bar_time, "bar_time")
+        expected = make_signal_id(
+            strategy_id, version, position.symbol, StrategyRole.SELL, normalized_bar_time
+        )
+        if signal_id != expected:
+            raise ValueError("signal_id does not match strategy, symbol, side, and bar time")
+        if not isinstance(reason_codes, tuple) or not reason_codes or any(
+            not isinstance(code, SellReasonCode) for code in reason_codes
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("reason_codes must be a non-empty tuple of SellReasonCode")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "signal_id", signal_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_id", strategy_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "version", version)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", position.symbol)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "position_cycle_id", position.cycle_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", normalized_bar_time)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "quantity", position.quantity)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason_codes", reason_codes)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "action", SignalAction.EXIT_LONG)
+
+
+def evaluate_exit_eligibility(
+    *,
+    position: Position | None,
+    confirmed_remaining_quantity: Decimal | None,
+    enabled: bool,
+    context: MarketContext | None,
+    spec: StrategySpec,
+    source: ExitSource = ExitSource.STRATEGY_SELL,
+    minimum_hold: timedelta = timedelta(0),
+    evaluation_time: datetime | None = None,
+    position_opened_at: datetime | None = None,
+    direction: PositionDirection = PositionDirection.LONG,
+) -> tuple[SellReasonCode, ...]:
+    """Return eligibility diagnostics without consulting a wall clock.
+
+    ``evaluation_time`` must be injected when minimum hold applies. The
+    confirmed remainder comes from the engine's position/cycle snapshot; this
+    function never guesses it from an order or requested exit size.
+    Empty and non-empty ``reason_codes`` are not ambiguous: success is exactly
+    ``(ELIGIBLE,)``; failure always starts with NO_SIGNAL or NOT_ELIGIBLE.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(spec, StrategySpec) or spec.side is not StrategyRole.SELL:
+        raise ValueError("spec must describe a SELL strategy")
+    if not isinstance(source, ExitSource):
+        raise ValueError("source must be ExitSource")
+    if not isinstance(minimum_hold, timedelta) or minimum_hold < timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError("minimum_hold must be a non-negative timedelta")
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("enabled must be bool")
+    if not isinstance(direction, PositionDirection):
+        raise ValueError("direction must be PositionDirection")
+
+    failures: list[SellReasonCode] = []
+    disposition = SellReasonCode.NOT_ELIGIBLE
+    if not enabled:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.STRATEGY_DISABLED)
+    if context is None:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NO_DATA)
+    elif context.freshness.stale:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.STALE_DATA)
+    elif not context.completed_bars_only:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.INCOMPLETE_DATA)
+    elif not context.feed_id or any(not context.candles.get(tf) for tf in spec.required_timeframes):
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NO_DATA)
+    elif len(context.candles.get(spec.trigger_timeframe, ())) < spec.warmup_bars:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NOT_WARMED)
+
+    if position is None:
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.FLAT_POSITION)
+    elif position.management is not ManagementStatus.MANAGED or position.cycle_id is None:
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.UNMANAGED_POSITION)
+    if direction is not PositionDirection.LONG:
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NOT_LONG)
+    if confirmed_remaining_quantity is None:
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NON_POSITIVE_QUANTITY)
+    elif (
+        isinstance(confirmed_remaining_quantity, bool)
+        or not isinstance(confirmed_remaining_quantity, Decimal)
+        or not confirmed_remaining_quantity.is_finite()
+        or confirmed_remaining_quantity <= 0
+    ):
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NON_POSITIVE_QUANTITY)
+
+    if (
+        not failures
+        and min_hold_applies(source)
+        and minimum_hold > timedelta(0)
+    ):
+        if position is None or position_opened_at is None or evaluation_time is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "minimum-hold evaluation requires position_opened_at and evaluation_time"
+            )
+        elapsed = _utc(evaluation_time, "evaluation_time") - _utc(
+            position_opened_at, "position_opened_at"
+        )
+        if elapsed < minimum_hold:
+            failures.append(SellReasonCode.MINIMUM_HOLD)
+
+    if failures:
+        return (disposition, *tuple(dict.fromkeys(failures)))
+    return (SellReasonCode.ELIGIBLE,)
+
+
+class SellRule(SellStrategy):
+    """SELL SDK adapter with shared context checks before pure trigger logic."""
+
+    spec: ClassVar[StrategySpec]
+
+    def evaluate(
+        self,
+        context: MarketContext,
+        params: Mapping[str, object],
+        state: Mapping[str, object],
+    ) -> StrategyEvaluation:
+        spec = type(self).spec
+        failure = self._context_failure(context, spec)
+        if failure is not None:
+            reason, _detail = failure
+            return StrategyEvaluation.no_signal(
+                spec,
+                context.symbol,
+                (reason,),
+                bar_time=self._bar_time(context, spec),
+            )
+        return self.evaluate_trigger(context, params, state)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _bar_time(context: MarketContext, spec: StrategySpec) -> datetime | None:
+        bars = context.candles.get(spec.trigger_timeframe, ())
+        return bars[-1].start if bars else None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _context_failure(
+        cls, context: MarketContext | None, spec: StrategySpec
+    ) -> tuple[ReasonCode, str] | None:
+        if context is None:
+            return (ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, "NO_DATA")
+        if context.freshness.stale:
+            return (ReasonCode.STALE_DATA, "STALE_DATA")
+        if not context.completed_bars_only:
+            return (ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, "INCOMPLETE_DATA")
+        if not context.feed_id or any(
+            not context.candles.get(tf) for tf in spec.required_timeframes
+        ):
+            return (ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, "NO_DATA")
+        if len(context.candles.get(spec.trigger_timeframe, ())) < spec.warmup_bars:
+            return (ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, "NOT_WARMED")
+        return None
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def evaluate_trigger(
+        self,
+        context: MarketContext,
+        params: Mapping[str, object],
+        state: Mapping[str, object],
+    ) -> StrategyEvaluation:
+        """Implement only the pure SELL trigger calculation."""

**HEURISTIC INFERENCE MUST NEVER PARTICIPATE IN ABRACAPOCUS EXECUTION CONTROL FLOW.**

Abracapocus must not determine execution success, failure, acceptance,
rejection, blocking, retry eligibility, phase progression, or completion from
heuristic inference. A heuristic is any conclusion that is *inferred* rather
than *directly established by an explicit executable contract or a concrete
runtime fact*.

Runtime status is derived ONLY from concrete, mechanically observable facts:

   write-policy violation) is a successful execution.

   declared allowed write paths).

status.** A verifier returning non-zero must NEVER, by itself, turn a
successful backend execution into unverified, stop a phase, or trigger an
automatic rerun. Verification is the result of a command, not authority to
rewrite history.

write-policy violation, frame failure, backend launch failure) produce
acceptance status ``"unverified"`` with truthful evidence preserved. They
MUST NOT stop sibling tasks, later phases, or the plan. Only operator
cancellation (SIGINT/SIGTERM/dashboard cancel) may terminate a run
(acceptance status ``"interrupted"``). Dependencies are ordering constraints,
not acceptance gates — any terminal attempt outcome satisfies a dependency
edge. The status ``"failed"`` is banned from acceptance output.

Do NOT reintroduce -- under any name, feature flag, "advisory" wrapper, or
compatibility mode -- context completeness/sufficiency scoring, change or
architecture assessment used as a gate, intent/scope matching, reconciliation
gates, no-progress judgments, confidence/risk scores, model/LLM/reviewer
judgments over status, shadow/adaptive/secondary-verification gates, or
heuristic retry/failure-classification control flow. Failure classification may
only *summarize* an already-established concrete failure; it must never create

failures. Future agents must not add these systems back.

those (only the standard library and pure domain/market-data value types).

1. ``StrategyRole`` (BUY/SELL) from ``domain.strategy_types`` is the side type;
   ``CandleTimeframe`` from ``market_data.candles`` is the timeframe type.  The
   strategy-facing ``MarketContext`` is ``market_data.context.MarketContext``,
   imported for type checking only.
2. ``make_signal_id`` here is the strategy-level identity (strategy id, version,
   symbol, side, triggering bar).  It is distinct from

   id and action; the domain ``Signal`` is built later by the engine.
3. The triggering bar timestamp is the closed bar's start (``Candle.start``),
   normalized to UTC; the same bar therefore always yields the same ID.
4. Evaluations carry reason codes and an optional signal ID only.  They have no
   confidence score, quantity, or order data.
5. Parameters without a default are required.  ``Decimal`` parameters accept

            ) from None
        if not isinstance(self.kind, ParameterKind):
            raise self._spec_error("kind must be ParameterKind")
        if not isinstance(self.description, str):
            raise self._spec_error("description must be str")

        if self.kind is ParameterKind.ENUM:
            if not isinstance(self.choices, tuple) or not self.choices:
                raise self._spec_error("ENUM parameters require a non-empty choices tuple")
            if any(not isinstance(c, str) or not c for c in self.choices):
                raise self._spec_error("choices must be non-empty strings")
            if len(set(self.choices)) != len(self.choices):
                raise self._spec_error("choices must be unique")
        elif self.choices:
            raise self._spec_error("choices are only allowed for ENUM parameters")

        if self.kind not in _RANGED_KINDS and (
            self.min_value is not None or self.max_value is not None
        ):
            raise self._spec_error(f"{self.kind.value} parameters do not support ranges")
        lower = None if self.min_value is None else self._check_type(self.min_value)
        upper = None if self.max_value is None else self._check_type(self.max_value)
        if lower is not None and upper is not None and lower > upper:  # type: ignore[operator]
            raise self._spec_error("min_value must be <= max_value")
        object.__setattr__(self, "min_value", lower)
        object.__setattr__(self, "max_value", upper)

        if self.default is not None:
            object.__setattr__(self, "default", self.validate_value(self.default))

    @property
    def required(self) -> bool:
        return self.default is None

    def _spec_error(self, message: str) -> ParameterValidationError:
        return ParameterValidationError(
            f"parameter {self.name}: {message}", code="invalid_spec", parameter=self.name
        )

    def _wrong_type(self, value: object, expected: str) -> ParameterValidationError:
        return ParameterValidationError(
            f"parameter {self.name} must be {expected}; got {type(value).__name__}",
            code="wrong_type",
            parameter=self.name,
        )

    def _check_type(self, value: object) -> object:
        """Return ``value`` normalized to this kind, or raise ``wrong_type``."""
        kind = self.kind
        if kind is ParameterKind.BOOL:
            if not isinstance(value, bool):
                raise self._wrong_type(value, "bool")
            return value
        if kind is ParameterKind.INT:
            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
                raise self._wrong_type(value, "int")
            return value
        if kind is ParameterKind.DECIMAL:
            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (Decimal, int)):
                raise self._wrong_type(value, "Decimal (float is not allowed)")
            result = value if isinstance(value, Decimal) else Decimal(value)
            if not result.is_finite():
                raise ParameterValidationError(
                    f"parameter {self.name} must be finite; got {result!s}",
                    code="out_of_range",
                    parameter=self.name,
                )
            return result
        if kind is ParameterKind.TIME_OF_DAY:
            if not isinstance(value, time) or value.tzinfo is not None:
                raise self._wrong_type(value, "naive datetime.time")
            return value
"""Explicit, trusted registry of Python strategy classes.

Strategy classes are registered by the composition root with a plain call
(``registry.register(MyBuyStrategy)``) after importing them normally.  There is
no dynamic code evaluation, no entry-point or path-based plugin discovery, and
no rules DSL.  One registry holds both sides, keyed by ``(strategy_id,
version)``; BUY and SELL entries are independent and never require a partner.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
from collections.abc import Mapping

from mike_trade.domain.errors import MikeTradeError
from mike_trade.domain.strategy_types import StrategyRole
from mike_trade.strategies.base import BuyStrategy, SellStrategy, StrategySpec

__all__ = ["StrategyRegistryError", "StrategyRegistry"]

StrategyClass = type[BuyStrategy] | type[SellStrategy]

_SIDE_BASES: dict[StrategyRole, StrategyClass] = {
    StrategyRole.BUY: BuyStrategy,
    StrategyRole.SELL: SellStrategy,
}


class StrategyRegistryError(MikeTradeError):
    """Registration or lookup failed.

    ``code`` is one of ``duplicate_registration``, ``invalid_strategy`` or
    ``not_found``.
    """


class StrategyRegistry:
    """Maps ``(strategy_id, version)`` to a registered strategy class."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._entries: dict[tuple[str, str], StrategyClass] = {}

    def register(self, strategy_cls: StrategyClass) -> StrategyClass:
        """Register a concrete ``BuyStrategy``/``SellStrategy`` subclass.

        Raises ``StrategyRegistryError`` for an invalid class or a duplicate
        ``(strategy_id, version)``.  Returns the class unchanged.
        """
        if not inspect.isclass(strategy_cls) or not issubclass(
            strategy_cls, (BuyStrategy, SellStrategy)
        ):
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"{strategy_cls!r} is not a BuyStrategy or SellStrategy subclass",
                code="invalid_strategy",
            )
        if inspect.isabstract(strategy_cls):
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"{strategy_cls.__name__} is abstract and cannot be registered",
                code="invalid_strategy",
            )
        spec = getattr(strategy_cls, "spec", None)
        if not isinstance(spec, StrategySpec):
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"{strategy_cls.__name__} must define a StrategySpec as `spec`",
                code="invalid_strategy",
            )
        if not issubclass(strategy_cls, _SIDE_BASES[spec.side]):
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"{strategy_cls.__name__} spec side {spec.side.value} does not match its base",
                code="invalid_strategy",
            )
        key = (spec.strategy_id, spec.version)
        if key in self._entries:
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"strategy {spec.strategy_id} {spec.version} is already registered",
                code="duplicate_registration",
                context={"strategy_id": spec.strategy_id, "version": spec.version},
            )
        self._entries[key] = strategy_cls
        return strategy_cls

    def get(self, strategy_id: str, version: str | None = None) -> StrategyClass:
        """Return the pinned ``version``, or the highest semantic version if omitted."""
        if version is not None:
            try:
                return self._entries[(strategy_id, version)]
            except KeyError:
                raise StrategyRegistryError(
                    f"strategy {strategy_id} {version} is not registered",
                    code="not_found",
                    context={"strategy_id": strategy_id, "version": version},
                ) from None
        candidates = [cls for (sid, _), cls in self._entries.items() if sid == strategy_id]
        if not candidates:
            raise StrategyRegistryError(
                f"strategy {strategy_id} is not registered",
                code="not_found",
                context={"strategy_id": strategy_id},
            )
        return max(candidates, key=lambda cls: cls.spec.version_key)

    def list_strategies(self, side: StrategyRole | None = None) -> tuple[StrategyClass, ...]:
        """Return registered classes, optionally for one side, ordered by id then version."""
        if side is not None and not isinstance(side, StrategyRole):
            raise ValueError(f"side must be StrategyRole or None; got {type(side).__name__}")
        selected = [cls for cls in self._entries.values() if side is None or cls.spec.side is side]
        return tuple(sorted(selected, key=lambda cls: (cls.spec.strategy_id, cls.spec.version_key)))

    def validate_parameters(
        self, strategy_id: str, params: Mapping[str, object], version: str | None = None
    ) -> Mapping[str, object]:
        """Validate ``params`` against the strategy spec's schema (delegated)."""
        return self.get(strategy_id, version).spec.parameter_schema.validate(params)

    Demo.spec = spec  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return Demo

"""Immutable, broker-neutral signal, provenance, and decision contracts.

Only standard-library modules are imported at runtime.  Signals deliberately
contain no quantity, order, fill, broker, or position-cycle state.

Design choice (3 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
3. Signal IDs use the full 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of a compact JSON
   array containing trimmed instance ID, normalized symbol, action value, and
   the bar instant normalized to a microsecond-precision UTC ``Z`` timestamp.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from enum import Enum
from types import MappingProxyType

__all__ = [
    "SignalAction",
    "ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS",
    "SignalProvenance",
    "make_signal_id",
    "Signal",
    "DecisionOutcome",
    "SignalDecision",
]

_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")


def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _to_decimal(value: object, *, field: str) -> Decimal:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        result = value
    elif isinstance(value, int):
        result = Decimal(value)
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        text = value.strip()
        if not text:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty numeric string")
        try:
            result = Decimal(text)
        except InvalidOperation:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal string: {value!r}") from None
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if not result.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite; got {result!s}")
    return result


class SignalAction(Enum):
    """Signal actions; short-side members are reserved but dormant."""

    ENTER_LONG = "ENTER_LONG"
    EXIT_LONG = "EXIT_LONG"
    ENTER_SHORT = "ENTER_SHORT"
    COVER_SHORT = "COVER_SHORT"


ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS = frozenset({SignalAction.ENTER_LONG, SignalAction.EXIT_LONG})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SignalProvenance:
    """The market-data and optional research evidence behind a signal."""

    data_provider: str
    data_feed: str
    is_consolidated: bool
    timeframe: str
    bar_time: datetime
    indicator_snapshot: Mapping[str, Decimal | None]
    research_source: str | None = None
    research_as_of: datetime | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "data_provider",
            _require_non_empty_str(self.data_provider, field="data_provider"),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "data_feed", _require_non_empty_str(self.data_feed, field="data_feed")
        )
        if not isinstance(self.is_consolidated, bool):
            raise ValueError("is_consolidated must be bool")
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "timeframe", _require_non_empty_str(self.timeframe, field="timeframe")
        )
        object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
        if not isinstance(self.indicator_snapshot, Mapping):
            raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot must be a mapping")
        snapshot: dict[str, Decimal | None] = {}
        for key, value in self.indicator_snapshot.items():
            if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
                raise ValueError("indicator_snapshot keys must be non-empty strings")
            snapshot[key] = None if value is None else _to_decimal(value, field=f"indicator[{key}]")
        object.__setattr__(self, "indicator_snapshot", MappingProxyType(snapshot))
        if self.research_source is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                "research_source",
                _require_non_empty_str(self.research_source, field="research_source"),
            )
        if self.research_as_of is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                "research_as_of",
                _require_utc(self.research_as_of, field="research_as_of"),
            )


def make_signal_id(
    instance_id: str,
    symbol: str,
    action: SignalAction,
    bar_time: datetime,
) -> str:
    """Return a stable SHA-256 identifier for one instance/action/bar."""
    normalized_instance = _require_non_empty_str(instance_id, field="instance_id")
    normalized_symbol = _require_symbol(symbol, field="symbol")
    if not isinstance(action, SignalAction):
        raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(action).__name__}")
    normalized_bar_time = _require_utc(bar_time, field="bar_time")
    timestamp = normalized_bar_time.isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
    canonical = json.dumps(
        [normalized_instance, normalized_symbol, action.value, timestamp],
        ensure_ascii=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    )
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Signal:
    """A strategy's immutable long-only actionable result."""

    signal_id: str
    strategy_key: str
    strategy_version: str
    instance_id: str
    symbol: str
    action: SignalAction
    bar_time: datetime
    generated_at: datetime
    reference_price: Decimal | None
    reason: str
    provenance: SignalProvenance
    confidence: Decimal | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        strategy_key = _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key")
        strategy_version = _require_non_empty_str(
            self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"
        )
        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
        if not isinstance(self.action, SignalAction):
            raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(self.action).__name__}")
        if self.action not in ENABLED_SIGNAL_ACTIONS:
            raise ValueError(f"signal action {self.action.value} is not enabled")
        bar_time = _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time")
        generated_at = _require_utc(self.generated_at, field="generated_at")
        if generated_at < bar_time:
            raise ValueError("generated_at must be >= bar_time")
        if not isinstance(self.provenance, SignalProvenance):
            raise ValueError("provenance must be SignalProvenance")
        reference_price = None
        if self.reference_price is not None:
            reference_price = _to_decimal(self.reference_price, field="reference_price")
            if reference_price <= 0:
                raise ValueError("reference_price must be > 0")
        confidence = None
        if self.confidence is not None:
            confidence = _to_decimal(self.confidence, field="confidence")
            if confidence < 0 or confidence > 1:
                raise ValueError("confidence must be between 0 and 1 inclusive")
        reason = _require_non_empty_str(self.reason, field="reason")

        expected_signal_id = make_signal_id(instance_id, symbol, self.action, bar_time)
        if self.signal_id != expected_signal_id:
            raise ValueError("signal_id does not match the signal identity fields")

        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_key", strategy_key)
        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_version", strategy_version)
        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)

"""Immutable strategy definitions, registrations, and evaluation results.

This module uses only the Python standard library.  In particular, it does
not import market, broker, account, order, or protection types at runtime.

Design choices (2 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
1. Symbols are stripped and uppercased at the contract boundary, matching the
   normalization used by the rest of the domain while keeping strategy keys
   strictly lowercase snake_case.
2. Parameter mappings are defensively shallow-copied into ``MappingProxyType``;
   the contract makes the mapping itself read-only without prescribing or
   transforming strategy-specific parameter values.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from enum import Enum
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from mike_trade.domain.signals import Signal

    "StrategyRole",
    "StrategyDefinition",
    "StrategyInstance",
    "EvaluationStatus",
    "Evaluation",
]

_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")


def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _read_only_mapping(value: object, *, field: str) -> Mapping[str, object]:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a mapping; got {type(value).__name__}")
    copied: dict[str, object] = {}
    for key, item in value.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} keys must be non-empty strings")
        copied[key] = item
    return MappingProxyType(copied)


def _string_tuple(value: object, *, field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a tuple")
    if any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item.strip() for item in value):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} items must be non-empty strings")
    return tuple(item.strip() for item in value)

                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal symbol must match")
        elif self.signal is not None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.status.value} evaluations must not contain a signal")

        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.ERROR and not self.error_detail:
            raise ValueError("ERROR evaluations require error_detail")
"""Immutable market-data value objects: events, candles, and context.

Standard library only (dataclasses, Enum, decimal, datetime, MappingProxyType).
Imports ``MarketSession``/``SessionKind`` from the sibling ``instruments``
module only; never broker SDKs, adapters, strategy code, or third-party
packages. Numeric/datetime validation mirrors ``instruments`` via private
helpers so this module has no other runtime ``mike_trade`` dependencies
besides ``instruments``.

Design choices (3):
1. ``Timeframe`` members are named M1/M5/M15/H1/D1 with string values
   ("1m", "5m", "15m", "1h", "1d") and expose a ``duration`` timedelta.
2. ``MarketContext`` validates that every candle's symbol matches the context
   symbol, every candle's timeframe matches its mapping key, and each tuple
   is in ascending, non-overlapping start order; mappings are defensively
   copied into ``MappingProxyType`` so callers can never mutate context state.
3. ``BAR`` market events only validate provided numerics (price > 0 when
   present, others >= 0); the bid<=ask cross-check applies whenever both bid
   and ask are present and positive, regardless of kind.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

def _to_decimal(value: Decimal | int | str, *, field: str) -> Decimal:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        result = value
    elif isinstance(value, int):
        result = Decimal(value)
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        text = value.strip()
        if not text:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty numeric string")
        try:
            result = Decimal(text)
        except InvalidOperation:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal string: {value!r}") from None
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if result.is_nan() or result.is_infinite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite; got {result!s}")
    return result


def _opt_decimal(value: Decimal | int | str | None, *, field: str) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _to_decimal(value, field=field)


def _require_utc(ts: datetime, *, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(ts, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(ts).__name__}")
    if ts.tzinfo is None or ts.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return ts.astimezone(UTC)


def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    import re as _re

    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    normalized = value.strip().upper()
    if _re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z][A-Z0-9.\-]{0,9}", normalized) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} is invalid: {value!r}")
    return normalized

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class MarketEvent:
    """One immutable trade, quote, or bar event with feed provenance."""

    symbol: str
    kind: MarketEventKind
    event_time: datetime
    received_at: datetime
    provenance: FeedProvenance
    price: Decimal | None = None
    size: Decimal | None = None
    bid: Decimal | None = None
    ask: Decimal | None = None
    bid_size: Decimal | None = None
    ask_size: Decimal | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol"))
        if not isinstance(self.kind, MarketEventKind):
            raise ValueError(f"kind must be MarketEventKind; got {type(self.kind).__name__}")
        object.__setattr__(self, "event_time", _require_utc(self.event_time, field="event_time"))
        object.__setattr__(self, "received_at", _require_utc(self.received_at, field="received_at"))
        if not isinstance(self.provenance, FeedProvenance):
            raise ValueError("provenance must be FeedProvenance")
        price = _opt_decimal(self.price, field="price")
        size = _opt_decimal(self.size, field="size")
        bid = _opt_decimal(self.bid, field="bid")
        ask = _opt_decimal(self.ask, field="ask")
        bid_size = _opt_decimal(self.bid_size, field="bid_size")
        ask_size = _opt_decimal(self.ask_size, field="ask_size")
        for label, val in (("price", price), ("size", size), ("bid", bid),
                           ("ask", ask), ("bid_size", bid_size), ("ask_size", ask_size)):
            object.__setattr__(self, label, val)
        if self.kind is MarketEventKind.TRADE:
            if price is None or price <= 0:
                raise ValueError("TRADE events require price > 0")
            if size is None or size < 0:
                raise ValueError("TRADE events require size >= 0")
        elif self.kind is MarketEventKind.QUOTE:
            if bid is None or bid < 0:
                raise ValueError("QUOTE events require bid >= 0")
            if ask is None or ask < 0:
                raise ValueError("QUOTE events require ask >= 0")
        else:  # BAR
            if price is not None and price <= 0:
                raise ValueError("BAR price must be > 0 when provided")
            for label, val in (("size", size), ("bid", bid), ("ask", ask),
                               ("bid_size", bid_size), ("ask_size", ask_size)):
                if val is not None and val < 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"BAR {label} must be >= 0 when provided")
        if bid is not None and ask is not None and bid > 0 and ask > 0 and bid > ask:
            raise ValueError(f"bid ({bid!s}) must be <= ask ({ask!s}) when both are positive")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Candle:
    """One immutable OHLCV candle with feed provenance."""

    symbol: str
    timeframe: Timeframe
    start: datetime
    end: datetime
    open: Decimal  # noqa: A003 - domain uses OHLC field names
    high: Decimal
    low: Decimal
    close: Decimal
    volume: Decimal
    provenance: FeedProvenance
    vwap: Decimal | None = None
    trade_count: int | None = None
    closed: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol"))
        if not isinstance(self.timeframe, Timeframe):
            raise ValueError(f"timeframe must be Timeframe; got {type(self.timeframe).__name__}")
        start = _require_utc(self.start, field="start")
        end = _require_utc(self.end, field="end")
        if end != start + self.timeframe.duration:
            raise ValueError("end must equal start + timeframe duration")
        object.__setattr__(self, "start", start)
        object.__setattr__(self, "end", end)
        o = _to_decimal(self.open, field="open")
        h = _to_decimal(self.high, field="high")
        lo = _to_decimal(self.low, field="low")
        c = _to_decimal(self.close, field="close")
        for label, val in (("open", o), ("high", h), ("low", lo), ("close", c)):
            if val <= 0:
                raise ValueError(f"{label} must be > 0; got {val!s}")
            object.__setattr__(self, label, val)
        volume = _to_decimal(self.volume, field="volume")
        if volume < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"volume must be >= 0; got {volume!s}")
        object.__setattr__(self, "volume", volume)
        if lo > min(o, c):
            raise ValueError(f"low ({lo!s}) must be <= min(open, close)")
        if max(o, c) > h:
            raise ValueError(f"high ({h!s}) must be >= max(open, close)")
        vwap = _opt_decimal(self.vwap, field="vwap")
        if vwap is not None and vwap <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"vwap must be > 0; got {vwap!s}")
        object.__setattr__(self, "vwap", vwap)
        if self.trade_count is not None:
            if isinstance(self.trade_count, bool) or not isinstance(self.trade_count, int):
                raise ValueError("trade_count must be int or None")
            if self.trade_count < 0:
                raise ValueError("trade_count must be >= 0")
        if not isinstance(self.closed, bool):
            raise ValueError("closed must be bool")
        if not isinstance(self.provenance, FeedProvenance):
            raise ValueError("provenance must be FeedProvenance")

fetching.  The builder only reads state already held by its injected sources (the
h.1 candle builder, the quote/trade cache, the h.3 calendar, and a clock).  It makes

1. ``MarketContext`` here is the strategy-facing snapshot keyed by
   ``(symbol, as_of, version)``; it is distinct from the older
   ``mike_trade.domain.market.MarketContext`` and reuses the h.1 ``Candle`` type.
2. ``candles`` holds CLOSED candles only (enforced by the value object).  A
   developing candle appears solely in ``developing_candles`` and only when the
   strategy declared ``completed_bars_only=False``.  Indicators are always computed
   from closed candles, never from the developing one.
3. Integrity fails closed: mixed ``(feed_id, consolidated)`` pairs, any non-RAW candle
   (stop-relevant prices are always RAW), a developing candle in ``candles``, or data
   timestamped after ``as_of`` raise ``ContextIntegrityError`` with a reason code.
4. Staleness is data age relative to ``as_of``; a stale context is still a valid value
   but is flagged, and :func:`select_context` never presents it as fresh.
5. The builder does not call ``CandleBuilder.close_due``; the owner of the candle
   builder drives bar closing, so a build never mutates a source.

    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (Decimal, int)):
        raise _invalid(f"{field} must be a Decimal or int")
    result = Decimal(value)
    if not result.is_finite() or (result <= 0 if positive else result < 0):

class NyseCalendar:
    """Adapter over the module-level h.3 NYSE calendar functions."""

    def session_status(self, at_utc: datetime) -> SessionStatus:
        return _nyse.session_status(at_utc)

    def session_id(self, at_utc: datetime) -> str | None:
        """Session id of the trading day containing ``at_utc`` (ET), or None."""
        if _nyse.session_status(at_utc) is SessionStatus.UNKNOWN:
            return None
        day: date = at_utc.astimezone(_nyse.NEW_YORK).date()
        if not _nyse.is_trading_day(day):
            return None
        session: Session = _nyse.session_for(day)
        return session.session_id

def make_signal_id(
    strategy_id: str,
    version: str,
    symbol: str,
    side: StrategyRole,
    bar_time: datetime,
) -> str:
    """Return the stable SHA-256 ID for one strategy/version/symbol/side/bar.

    ``bar_time`` is the triggering completed bar's start, normalized to UTC.
    """
    if not isinstance(side, StrategyRole):
        raise ValueError(f"side must be StrategyRole; got {type(side).__name__}")
    timestamp = _require_utc(bar_time, field="bar_time").isoformat(timespec="microseconds")
    canonical = json.dumps(
        [
            _require_identifier(strategy_id, field="strategy_id"),
            _require_semver(version),
            _require_symbol(symbol, field="symbol"),
            side.value,
            timestamp.replace("+00:00", "Z"),
        ],
        ensure_ascii=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    )
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class StrategyEvaluation:
    """Either a signal (with deterministic ``signal_id``) or a no-signal result.

    Build with :meth:`for_signal` or :meth:`no_signal`, which check reason codes
    against the strategy's declared ``spec.reason_codes``.  Carries no
    confidence score.  ``state_updates`` are values for the strategy's declared
    ``persistent_state_keys``; the engine, not the strategy, persists them.
    """

    strategy_id: str
    version: str
    symbol: str
    side: StrategyRole
    reason_codes: tuple[ReasonCode, ...]
    bar_time: datetime | None = None
    signal_id: str | None = None
    reference_price: Decimal | None = None
    state_updates: Mapping[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        _require_identifier(self.strategy_id, field="strategy_id")
        _require_semver(self.version)
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol"))
        if not isinstance(self.side, StrategyRole):
            raise ValueError("side must be StrategyRole")
        if (
            not isinstance(self.reason_codes, tuple)
            or not self.reason_codes
            or any(not isinstance(code, ReasonCode) for code in self.reason_codes)
        ):
            raise ValueError("reason_codes must be a non-empty tuple of ReasonCode")
        if self.bar_time is not None:
            object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
        if self.reference_price is not None and (
            isinstance(self.reference_price, bool)
            or not isinstance(self.reference_price, Decimal)
            or not self.reference_price.is_finite()
            or self.reference_price <= 0
        ):
            raise ValueError("reference_price must be a positive finite Decimal")
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "state_updates", _read_only_mapping(self.state_updates, field="state_updates")
        )

        if self.signal_id is None:
            if ReasonCode.SIGNAL in self.reason_codes:
                raise ValueError("SIGNAL reason code requires a signal_id")
            if self.reference_price is not None:
                raise ValueError("no-signal evaluations must not carry reference_price")
        else:
            if self.reason_codes != (ReasonCode.SIGNAL,):
                raise ValueError("signal evaluations must carry exactly (SIGNAL,)")
            if self.bar_time is None:
                raise ValueError("signal evaluations require bar_time")
            expected = make_signal_id(
                self.strategy_id, self.version, self.symbol, self.side, self.bar_time
            )
            if self.signal_id != expected:
                raise ValueError("signal_id does not match the signal identity fields")

    @property
    def is_signal(self) -> bool:
        return self.signal_id is not None

    @classmethod
    def for_signal(
        cls,
        spec: StrategySpec,
        symbol: str,
        bar_time: datetime,
        *,
        reference_price: Decimal | None = None,
        state_updates: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> StrategyEvaluation:
        """Build a signal result whose ID is derived from the triggering bar."""
        return cls(
            strategy_id=spec.strategy_id,
            version=spec.version,
            symbol=symbol,
            side=spec.side,
            reason_codes=(ReasonCode.SIGNAL,),
            bar_time=bar_time,
            signal_id=make_signal_id(spec.strategy_id, spec.version, symbol, spec.side, bar_time),
            reference_price=reference_price,
            state_updates=state_updates or {},
        )

    @classmethod
    def no_signal(
        cls,
        spec: StrategySpec,
        symbol: str,
        reason_codes: tuple[ReasonCode, ...] = (ReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL,),
        *,
        bar_time: datetime | None = None,
        state_updates: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> StrategyEvaluation:
        """Build a no-signal result; codes must be declared by ``spec``."""
        if not isinstance(reason_codes, tuple):
            raise ValueError("reason_codes must be a tuple")
        undeclared = [c for c in reason_codes if c not in spec.reason_codes]
        if undeclared:
            raise ValueError(
                f"reason codes not declared by {spec.strategy_id}: "
                f"{[c.value for c in undeclared]!r}"
            )
        return cls(
            strategy_id=spec.strategy_id,
            version=spec.version,
            symbol=symbol,
            side=spec.side,
            reason_codes=reason_codes,
            bar_time=bar_time,
            state_updates=state_updates or {},
        )

class _Strategy(ABC):
    """Shared contract: a class-level ``spec`` and a pure ``evaluate``."""

    spec: ClassVar[StrategySpec]

    def __init_subclass__(cls, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        super().__init_subclass__(**kwargs)
        declared = cls.__dict__.get("spec")
        if declared is None:

        if not isinstance(declared, StrategySpec):
            raise TypeError(f"{cls.__name__}.spec must be a StrategySpec")
        if declared.side is not cls._side:

            raise ValueError("cycle fills must be Fill instances")
        fill_ids = [fill.fill_id for fill in all_fills]
        if len(fill_ids) != len(set(fill_ids)):
            raise ValueError("fill_id values must be unique within a cycle")
        for fill in all_fills:
            if fill.account_scope_id != self.account_scope_id or fill.symbol != self.symbol:
                raise ValueError("fill account_scope_id and symbol must match the cycle")
        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY for fill in self.entry_fills):
            raise ValueError("entry fills must have BUY side")
        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL for fill in self.exit_fills):
            raise ValueError("exit fills must have SELL side")
        if self.exit_quantity > self.entry_quantity:
            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")

        opened_at = _optional_utc(self.opened_at, field="opened_at")
        closed_at = _optional_utc(self.closed_at, field="closed_at")
        object.__setattr__(self, "opened_at", opened_at)
        object.__setattr__(self, "closed_at", closed_at)
        if opened_at is not None and closed_at is not None and closed_at < opened_at:
            raise ValueError("closed_at must not be before opened_at")

        if self.state is PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY:
            if all_fills or opened_at is not None or closed_at is not None:
                raise ValueError("PENDING_ENTRY cycles cannot contain fills or lifecycle times")
        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.OPEN:
            if (
                not self.entry_fills
                or self.exit_fills
                or opened_at is None
                or closed_at is not None
            ):
                raise ValueError("OPEN cycles require entry fills only and opened_at")
        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.EXITING:
            if not self.entry_fills or self.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
                raise ValueError("EXITING cycles require a positive remaining quantity")
            if opened_at is None or closed_at is not None:
                raise ValueError("EXITING cycles require opened_at and no closed_at")
        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.CLOSED:
            if not self.entry_fills or self.remaining_quantity != _ZERO:
                raise ValueError("CLOSED cycles require a fully exited entry")
            if opened_at is None or closed_at is None:
                raise ValueError("CLOSED cycles require opened_at and closed_at")
        elif closed_at is not None and opened_at is None:
            raise ValueError("an ABANDONED cycle cannot close before it opens")

    def apply_entry_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
        if self.state not in {PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY, PositionCycleState.OPEN}:
            raise ValueError("entry fills are allowed only before exit begins")
        if self.exit_fills:
            raise ValueError("entry fills are not allowed after an exit fill")
        if fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY:
            raise ValueError("entry fill side must be BUY")
        if fill.fill_id in {item.fill_id for item in self.entry_fills}:
            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")
        opened_at = self.opened_at if self.opened_at is not None else fill.filled_at
        return replace(
            self,
            state=PositionCycleState.OPEN,
            entry_fills=self.entry_fills + (fill,),
            opened_at=opened_at,
        )

    def begin_exit(self) -> PositionCycle:
        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.OPEN or self.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
            raise ValueError("exit can begin only for an OPEN cycle with remaining quantity")
        return replace(self, state=PositionCycleState.EXITING)

    def apply_exit_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.EXITING:
            raise ValueError("exit fills require an EXITING cycle")
        if fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL:
            raise ValueError("exit fill side must be SELL")
        if fill.fill_id in {item.fill_id for item in self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills}:
            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")
        if fill.quantity > self.remaining_quantity:
            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")
        fills = self.exit_fills + (fill,)
        if fill.quantity == self.remaining_quantity:
            return replace(
                self,
                state=PositionCycleState.CLOSED,
                exit_fills=fills,
                closed_at=fill.filled_at,
            )
        return replace(self, exit_fills=fills)

    @property
    def entry_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return sum((fill.quantity for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO)

    @property
    def exit_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return sum((fill.quantity for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)

    @property
    def remaining_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.entry_quantity - self.exit_quantity

    @property
    def avg_entry_price(self) -> Decimal | None:
        if self.entry_quantity == _ZERO:
            return None
        cost = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO)
        return cost / self.entry_quantity

    @property
    def avg_exit_price(self) -> Decimal | None:
        if self.exit_quantity == _ZERO:
            return None
        proceeds = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
        return proceeds / self.exit_quantity

    @property
    def realized_pnl(self) -> Decimal:
        proceeds = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
        entry_cost = sum(
            (fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO
        )
        fees = sum((fill.fee for fill in self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
        return proceeds - entry_cost - fees

def _quote_snapshot(update: MarketDataUpdate, symbol: str) -> QuoteSnapshot:
    if update.kind != "quote" or update.symbol != symbol:
        raise _invalid(f"cache returned a non-quote or foreign-symbol update for {symbol}")
    return QuoteSnapshot(
        symbol=symbol,
        bid=update.bid,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        ask=update.ask,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        bid_size=_optional_size(update.get("bid_size")),
        ask_size=_optional_size(update.get("ask_size")),
        provider_ts=update.provider_source_ts,
        receive_ts=update.receive_ts,
        feed_id=update.feed_id,
    )


def _trade_snapshot(update: MarketDataUpdate, symbol: str) -> TradeSnapshot:
    if update.kind != "trade" or update.symbol != symbol:
        raise _invalid(f"cache returned a non-trade or foreign-symbol update for {symbol}")
    return TradeSnapshot(
        symbol=symbol,
        price=update.price,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        size=_optional_size(update.get("size")),
        provider_ts=update.provider_source_ts,
        receive_ts=update.receive_ts,
        feed_id=update.feed_id,
    )


def _optional_size(value: object) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, float):  # sizes from some providers arrive as floats
        value = Decimal(str(value))
    return _decimal(value, "size", positive=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ContextFreshness:
    """Data age relative to ``as_of`` plus an explicit stale flag and reason code."""

    newest_data_ts: datetime | None
    age: timedelta | None
    max_age: timedelta
    stale: bool
    reason: str | None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.newest_data_ts is not None:
            object.__setattr__(self, "newest_data_ts", _utc(self.newest_data_ts, "newest_data_ts"))
        if (self.newest_data_ts is None) != (self.age is None):
            raise _invalid("newest_data_ts and age must both be set or both be None")
        if self.age is not None and (not isinstance(self.age, timedelta) or self.age < _ZERO):
            raise _invalid("age must be a non-negative timedelta")
        if not isinstance(self.max_age, timedelta) or self.max_age <= _ZERO:
            raise _invalid("max_age must be a positive timedelta")
        if not isinstance(self.stale, bool):
            raise _invalid("stale must be bool")
        if self.stale and not (isinstance(self.reason, str) and self.reason):
            raise _invalid("stale freshness requires a reason code")
        if not self.stale and self.reason is not None:
            raise _invalid("fresh freshness must not carry a reason")

def _feed_pairs(
    candles: Iterable[Candle],
    quote: QuoteSnapshot | None,
    trade: TradeSnapshot | None,
) -> frozenset[tuple[str, bool]]:
    pairs = {(c.feed_id, c.consolidated) for c in candles}
    pairs.update((s.feed_id, _consolidated_for(s.feed_id)) for s in (quote, trade) if s)
    return frozenset(pairs)


def _check_feed(pairs: frozenset[tuple[str, bool]], symbol: str) -> None:
    if len(pairs) > 1:
        raise _integrity(
            CODE_FEED_MISMATCH,
            f"{symbol}: mixed feed identities {sorted(pairs)!r}",
            symbol=symbol,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class MarketContext:
    """Frozen strategy snapshot keyed by ``(symbol, as_of, version)``.

    ``candles`` contains CLOSED candles only.  ``developing_candles`` is empty unless
    the strategy explicitly declared ``completed_bars_only=False``.  ``price_basis`` is
    the basis of every stop-relevant price in the snapshot and is always RAW.
    """

    symbol: str
    as_of: datetime
    version: int
    feed_id: str | None
    consolidated: bool
    price_basis: PriceBasis
    session_status: SessionStatus
    session_id: str | None
    freshness: ContextFreshness
    candles: Mapping[CandleTimeframe, tuple[Candle, ...]]
    indicators: Mapping[str, Decimal | None]
    latest_quote: QuoteSnapshot | None = None
    latest_trade: TradeSnapshot | None = None
    developing_candles: Mapping[CandleTimeframe, Candle] | None = None
    completed_bars_only: bool = True
    research: ResearchContext | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        symbol = _symbol(self.symbol)
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
        as_of = _utc(self.as_of, "as_of")
        object.__setattr__(self, "as_of", as_of)
        if isinstance(self.version, bool) or not isinstance(self.version, int) or self.version < 1:
            raise _invalid("version must be a positive int")
        if not isinstance(self.price_basis, PriceBasis):
            raise _invalid("price_basis must be PriceBasis")
        if self.price_basis is not PriceBasis.RAW:
            raise _integrity(
                CODE_PRICE_BASIS_MISMATCH,
                f"{symbol}: stop-relevant prices must be RAW",
                symbol=symbol,
            )
        if not isinstance(self.consolidated, bool):
            raise _invalid("consolidated must be bool")
        if self.feed_id is not None:
            feed = _feed(self.feed_id)
            object.__setattr__(self, "feed_id", feed)
            if feed == "iex" and self.consolidated:
                raise _invalid("IEX feed is not consolidated")
        if not isinstance(self.session_status, SessionStatus):
            raise _invalid("session_status must be SessionStatus")
        if self.session_id is not None and not (
            isinstance(self.session_id, str) and self.session_id
        ):
            raise _invalid("session_id must be a non-empty str or None")
        if not isinstance(self.freshness, ContextFreshness):
            raise _invalid("freshness must be ContextFreshness")
        if not isinstance(self.completed_bars_only, bool):
            raise _invalid("completed_bars_only must be bool")
        if self.latest_quote is not None and not isinstance(self.latest_quote, QuoteSnapshot):
            raise _invalid("latest_quote must be QuoteSnapshot or None")
        if self.latest_trade is not None and not isinstance(self.latest_trade, TradeSnapshot):
            raise _invalid("latest_trade must be TradeSnapshot or None")
        if self.research is not None and not isinstance(self.research, ResearchContext):
            raise _invalid("research must be ResearchContext or None")

        closed = self._freeze_closed(self.candles, symbol, as_of)
        developing = self._freeze_developing(self.developing_candles, symbol)
        if self.completed_bars_only and developing:
            raise _invalid("developing candles require completed_bars_only=False")
        object.__setattr__(self, "candles", closed)
        object.__setattr__(self, "developing_candles", developing)
        object.__setattr__(self, "indicators", self._freeze_indicators(self.indicators))

        for quote_or_trade in (self.latest_quote, self.latest_trade):
            if quote_or_trade is None:
                continue
            if quote_or_trade.symbol != symbol:
                raise _invalid(f"{quote_or_trade.symbol} snapshot in {symbol} context")
            if quote_or_trade.receive_ts > as_of:
                raise _integrity(
                    CODE_FUTURE_DATA, f"{symbol}: quote/trade received after as_of", symbol=symbol
                )
        every_candle = [c for seq in closed.values() for c in seq] + list(developing.values())
        if any(c.price_basis is not self.price_basis for c in every_candle):
            raise _integrity(
                CODE_PRICE_BASIS_MISMATCH,
                f"{symbol}: SPLIT_ADJUSTED candles cannot accompany RAW stop prices",
                symbol=symbol,
            )
        pairs = _feed_pairs(every_candle, self.latest_quote, self.latest_trade)
        if self.feed_id is not None:
            pairs = pairs | {(self.feed_id, self.consolidated)}
        _check_feed(pairs, symbol)

    @staticmethod
    def _freeze_closed(
        candles: Mapping[CandleTimeframe, Iterable[Candle]], symbol: str, as_of: datetime
    ) -> Mapping[CandleTimeframe, tuple[Candle, ...]]:
        if not isinstance(candles, Mapping):
            raise _invalid("candles must be a mapping of CandleTimeframe to candles")
        frozen: dict[CandleTimeframe, tuple[Candle, ...]] = {}
        for key, value in candles.items():
            tf = _timeframe(key)
            seq = tuple(value)
            for candle in seq:
                if not isinstance(candle, Candle):
                    raise _invalid(f"candles[{tf.value}] must contain Candle objects")
                if candle.status is not CandleStatus.CLOSED:
                    raise _integrity(
                        CODE_DEVELOPING_IN_COMPLETED,
                        f"{symbol}: developing candle in completed candles[{tf.value}]",
                        symbol=symbol,
                    )
                if candle.symbol != symbol or candle.timeframe is not tf:
                    raise _invalid(f"candles[{tf.value}] holds a foreign symbol or timeframe")
                if candle.end > as_of:
                    raise _integrity(
                        CODE_FUTURE_DATA,
                        f"{symbol}: candle {candle.start.isoformat()} closes after as_of",
                        symbol=symbol,
                    )
            for prev, cur in zip(seq, seq[1:], strict=False):
                if cur.start < prev.end:
                    raise _invalid(f"candles[{tf.value}] must be ascending and non-overlapping")
            frozen[tf] = seq
        return MappingProxyType(frozen)

"""Immutable strategy definitions, registrations, and evaluation results.

This module uses only the Python standard library.  In particular, it does
not import market, broker, account, order, or protection types at runtime.

Design choices (2 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
1. Symbols are stripped and uppercased at the contract boundary, matching the
   normalization used by the rest of the domain while keeping strategy keys
   strictly lowercase snake_case.
2. Parameter mappings are defensively shallow-copied into ``MappingProxyType``;
   the contract makes the mapping itself read-only without prescribing or
   transforming strategy-specific parameter values.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from enum import Enum
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from mike_trade.domain.signals import Signal

__all__ = [
    "StrategyRole",
    "StrategyDefinition",
    "StrategyInstance",
    "EvaluationStatus",
    "Evaluation",
]

_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")


def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _read_only_mapping(value: object, *, field: str) -> Mapping[str, object]:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a mapping; got {type(value).__name__}")
    copied: dict[str, object] = {}
    for key, item in value.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} keys must be non-empty strings")
        copied[key] = item
    return MappingProxyType(copied)


def _string_tuple(value: object, *, field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a tuple")
    if any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item.strip() for item in value):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} items must be non-empty strings")
    return tuple(item.strip() for item in value)


class StrategyRole(Enum):
    """A strategy's independently registered entry or exit role."""

    BUY = "BUY"
    SELL = "SELL"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class StrategyDefinition:
    """Static metadata and defaults published by a strategy plugin."""

    strategy_key: str
    version: str
    role: StrategyRole
    description: str
    required_timeframes: tuple[str, ...]
    warmup_bars: int
    default_parameters: Mapping[str, object]

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "strategy_key",
            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
        )
        object.__setattr__(self, "version", _require_non_empty_str(self.version, field="version"))
        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
        if not isinstance(self.description, str):
            raise ValueError("description must be str")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "required_timeframes",
            _string_tuple(self.required_timeframes, field="required_timeframes"),
        )
        if isinstance(self.warmup_bars, bool) or not isinstance(self.warmup_bars, int):
            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be int")
        if self.warmup_bars < 0:
            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be >= 0")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "default_parameters",
            _read_only_mapping(self.default_parameters, field="default_parameters"),
        )

    else:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if not result.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite; got {result!s}")
    return result

class SignalProvenance:
    """The market-data and optional research evidence behind a signal."""

        if self.research_as_of is not None:

def make_signal_id(
    instance_id: str,
    symbol: str,
    action: SignalAction,
    bar_time: datetime,
) -> str:
    """Return a stable SHA-256 identifier for one instance/action/bar."""
    normalized_instance = _require_non_empty_str(instance_id, field="instance_id")
    normalized_symbol = _require_symbol(symbol, field="symbol")
    if not isinstance(action, SignalAction):
        raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(action).__name__}")
    normalized_bar_time = _require_utc(bar_time, field="bar_time")
    timestamp = normalized_bar_time.isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
    canonical = json.dumps(
        [normalized_instance, normalized_symbol, action.value, timestamp],
        ensure_ascii=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    )
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Signal:
    """A strategy's immutable long-only actionable result."""

    signal_id: str
    strategy_key: str
    strategy_version: str
    instance_id: str

+    if not isinstance(direction, PositionDirection):
+        raise ValueError("direction must be PositionDirection")
+
+    failures: list[SellReasonCode] = []
+    disposition = SellReasonCode.NOT_ELIGIBLE
+    if not enabled:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.STRATEGY_DISABLED)
+    if context is None:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NO_DATA)
+    elif context.freshness.stale:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.STALE_DATA)
+    elif not context.completed_bars_only:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.INCOMPLETE_DATA)
+    elif not context.feed_id or any(not context.candles.get(tf) for tf in spec.required_timeframes):
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NO_DATA)
+    elif len(context.candles.get(spec.trigger_timeframe, ())) < spec.warmup_bars:
+        disposition = SellReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NOT_WARMED)
+
+    if position is None:
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.FLAT_POSITION)
+    elif position.management is not ManagementStatus.MANAGED or position.cycle_id is None:
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.UNMANAGED_POSITION)
+    if direction is not PositionDirection.LONG:
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NOT_LONG)
+    if confirmed_remaining_quantity is None:
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NON_POSITIVE_QUANTITY)
+    elif (
+        isinstance(confirmed_remaining_quantity, bool)
+        or not isinstance(confirmed_remaining_quantity, Decimal)
+        or not confirmed_remaining_quantity.is_finite()
+        or confirmed_remaining_quantity <= 0
+    ):
+        failures.append(SellReasonCode.NON_POSITIVE_QUANTITY)
+
+    if (
+        not failures
+        and min_hold_applies(source)
+        and minimum_hold > timedelta(0)
+    ):
+        if position is None or position_opened_at is None or evaluation_time is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "minimum-hold evaluation requires position_opened_at and evaluation_time"
+            )
+        elapsed = _utc(evaluation_time, "evaluation_time") - _utc(
+            position_opened_at, "position_opened_at"
+        )
+        if elapsed < minimum_hold:
+            failures.append(SellReasonCode.MINIMUM_HOLD)
+
+    if failures:
+        return (disposition, *tuple(dict.fromkeys(failures)))
+    return (SellReasonCode.ELIGIBLE,)
+
+
+class SellRule(SellStrategy):
+    """SELL SDK adapter with shared context checks before pure trigger logic."""
+
+    spec: ClassVar[StrategySpec]
+
+    def evaluate(
+        self,
+        context: MarketContext,
+        params: Mapping[str, object],
+        state: Mapping[str, object],
+    ) -> StrategyEvaluation:
+        spec = type(self).spec
+        failure = self._context_failure(context, spec)
+        if failure is not None:
+            reason, detail = failure
+            return StrategyEvaluation.no_signal(spec, context.symbol, (reason,), bar_time=self._bar_time(context, spec))
+        return self.evaluate_trigger(context, params, state)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _bar_time(context: MarketContext, spec: StrategySpec) -> datetime | None:
+        bars = context.candles.get(spec.trigger_timeframe, ())
+        return bars[-1].start if bars else None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _context_failure(
+        cls, context: MarketContext | None, spec: StrategySpec
+    ) -> tuple[ReasonCode, str] | None:
+        if context is None:
+            return (ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, "NO_DATA")
+        if context.freshness.stale:
+            return (ReasonCode.STALE_DATA, "STALE_DATA")
+        if not context.completed_bars_only:
+            return (ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, "INCOMPLETE_DATA")
+        if not context.feed_id or any(not context.candles.get(tf) for tf in spec.required_timeframes):
+            return (ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, "NO_DATA")
+        if len(context.candles.get(spec.trigger_timeframe, ())) < spec.warmup_bars:
+            return (ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, "NOT_WARMED")
+        return None
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def evaluate_trigger(
+        self,
+        context: MarketContext,
+        params: Mapping[str, object],
+        state: Mapping[str, object],
+    ) -> StrategyEvaluation:
+        """Implement only the pure SELL trigger calculation."""

+def spec() -> StrategySpec:

+        trigger_kind=TriggerKind.EDGE_ON_CLOSED_BAR,
+        trigger_timeframe=CandleTimeframe.M5,
+        parameter_schema=ParameterSchema(()),

+        methodology="contract test",
+        source="test",
+        execution_limitations=("Long-only",),
+        reason_codes=(ReasonCode.SIGNAL, ReasonCode.NO_SIGNAL, ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA,

+def test_recommendation_carries_exact_full_fractional_remainder_and_is_immutable():

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+def test_disabled_or_unusable_data_is_no_signal(updates, expected):

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", tuple(ExitSource))

+        for name in names
+        for token in ("partial", "confidence", "probability", "order", "broker")

+    assert ExitLongRecommendation.__dataclass_params__.frozen

+def test_sell_rule_is_a_sellstrategy_contract_and_trigger_is_abstract():

+def test_base_imports_no_execution_or_secret_modules():

+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+    forbidden = ("broker", "adapter", "persistence", "http", "secret")
+    imports = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            imports.extend(alias.name.lower() for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            imports.append((node.module or "").lower())
+    assert not [name for name in imports if any(word in name for word in forbidden)]
